test_title: PYST 68: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
'T × U' means 'T is the mother of U'

'T + U' means 'T is the sister of U'

'T ÷ U' means 'T is the daughter of U'

'T - U' means 'T is the wife of U'

How is D related to A in the expression 'A × B + C ÷ D'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: A × B + C ÷ D

A × B → A is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79d4c1d1fe76ffe7251bc5821b881f5f63dd2a69ac90d76f06e97eeb9fa5343b.png] 

B + C → B is the sister of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f193c7ab5dc9f63753feb00804ee3b69e56b5dfa95386392f854c2e3ed9de93.png] 

C ÷ D → C is the daughter of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed9331cf298163c59c59504871a3277ef9b159ccca7abe2ce3046dfdaeac2996.png] 

Thus, D is A's husband.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
